spiritgiven.comments: Great game, good intensity all the way through. We felt many of the Canadian calls and discussions were about benefiting Canada which is why we marked lower for rules knowledge and use and fair-mindedness. They were receptive to our spirit discussions after we talked to them which is why we marked up on communication.
Really intense but spirited game. Great long shots and connections.
Really nice team to play against. Good spirit the whole game. Any calls were resolved quickly and in good manner. Overall, a fun game to play!
Fun game, thanks for the intensity all the way until the end!
Nice, clean game. Kept fighting till the end. Overall, good spirit and an enjoyable game.
Crazy good long shots and grabs to back them up. Put up a really good zone. Amazing fight till the end and great spirit too.

spiritreceived.comments: Good first match. No major calls made. Noticeable good defence and good runs made. Really enjoyed our dancing and good luck in the rest of the tournament!
Perhaps watch a little on the double team during the poach (same on our side) but overall a well-spirited game! Thanks for the game :-)
This was a great game! Great spirit, communication, and knowledge! We thank them for the amazing game and wish them the best of luck the rest of the tournament.
Amazing game! Good spirit throughout the whole games and calls were resolved quickly!
Thank you for the close game, both team had tough game!
thanks for a very well spirited game and uplifting our girls as well as your own :)
What a fun and well fought game, thanks a lot!
It was a really really tough game and difficult game for us. Although we did trying our best we still lost. There were a lot of good plays, you guys deserves to win! Thank you for the good game!
